metadata.description: Official Apify Agent Skills for web scraping, data extraction, and automation

plugins.name: apify-ultimate-scraper
plugins.description: Universal AI-powered web scraper for 15+ platforms with ~100 Actors. Scrape data from Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Google Maps, Google Search, Google Trends, Reddit, Airbnb, Yelp, TripAdvisor, and more for lead generation, brand monitoring, competitor analysis, influencer discovery, trend research, content analytics, audience analysis, SEO intelligence, recruitment, and reviews

plugins.name: apify-actor-development
plugins.description: Create, modify, debug, and deploy Apify Actors, and write their input and output schemas

plugins.name: apify-actorization
plugins.description: Convert existing projects into Apify Actors - serverless cloud programs. Actorize JavaScript/TypeScript (SDK with Actor.init/exit), Python (async context manager), or any language (CLI wrapper)

plugins.name: apify-generate-output-schema
plugins.description: Deprecated: use apify-actor-development, which now generates Actor output schemas. This plugin will be removed in a future release

plugins.name: apify-integration-development
plugins.description: Design and build an official Apify integration for a company's product - workflow-automation apps (Zapier/n8n-style), AI agent harness plugins, AI framework packages (LangChain/LlamaIndex-style), or direct application clients via apify-client. Use when planning, creating, or reviewing an integration that exposes Apify Actors, runs, datasets, or key-value stores inside another product

plugins.name: apify-fix-git-connection
plugins.description: Repair an Apify Actor's broken Git connection - pushes to GitHub that no longer start a build, builds that fail to clone the repository, or a GitHub integration rejected as invalid or expired. Use when a Git-sourced Actor stopped deploying from its repository

plugins.name: apify-actor-runtime
plugins.description: Test and develop Apify Actors on a local Actor runtime instead of the Apify platform - install it via the Apify CLI, then load its version-matched skill with apify runtime skill. Use when building, running, debugging or testing an Actor locally

plugins.name: apify-api-to-server-actor
plugins.description: Turn an existing HTTP API into a pay-per-call, multi-tenant Apify Server Actor, so a company can sell its API on Apify Store. Maps the API's endpoints and pricing page to pay-per-event events that match the partner's own prices, and builds a tested Actor project with endpoint schema, Store README and launch plan

plugins.name: apify-actor-commands
plugins.description: Commands for Apify Actor development workflow
